# Test fixtures

Every file here is synthetic: written by hand for luxpath's tests, describing no real product. They are under the
repository's licence (MIT OR Apache-2.0). Manufacturers' files are never committed (AGENTS.md §1.3).

| File | Source | Licence | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `downlight.ies` | written by hand, 2026-10-21 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | IES LM-63-2002, rotationally symmetric, 1000 lm; 300/250/120/0 cd/klm at γ 0/30/60/90 |
| `downlight.ldt` | written by hand, 2026-10-21 | MIT OR Apache-2.0 | The same distribution as EULUMDAT (symmetry indicator 1), CRLF line ends |

The other test files (`tests/common/mod.rs`) are generated by the tests themselves, one per symmetry type.
